find-matching-licenses-description: Find matching licenses and their associated enterprise subscriptions
partial-license-key-search: Enter a partial license key to find matches
no-subscription-url-available: No subscription URL available (only accessible to site admins)
cody-gateway-description: Cody Gateway is a Sourcegraph managed service that allows customer instances to talk to upstream LLMs and generate embeddings under our negotiated terms with third party providers in a safe manner.
interval-definition: The interval is defined in seconds. See below for a pretty-printed version.
no-license-key-message: No license key has been generated yet.
license-creation-guide: Please read the <0>guide for how to create a license key for a new prospect or new customer.</0>
deprecated-plan-warning: This plan has been deprecated. Only issue a new license for this plan if you got approval to do so.
trial-license: This license is for a trial
customer-name-description: Name of the customer. Will be encoded into the key for easier identification.
salesforce-subscription-id-description: Enter the corresponding Subscription ID from Salesforce.
salesforce-opportunity-id-description: Enter the corresponding Opportunity ID from Salesforce.
maximum-users-description: The maximum number of users permitted on this license.
true-up-enabled-description: With true up enabled, the maximum user count is not enforced and additional users can join the instance. Bill for those users separately.
license-expiration-description: When this license expires. Sourcegraph will disable beyond this date. Usually the end date of the contract.
tags-description: Comma separated list of tags. Tags restrict a license.
tags-manual-specification-warning: Note that specifying tags manually is no longer required and the form should handle all options.
use-tags-caution: Only use this if you know what you're doing!
tags-display-warning: All the tags are displayed at the end of the form as well.
license-verification-warning: Please double check that the license tags and user count are correct before generating the license. The license cannot be modified once generated.
access-token-description: Access tokens can be used for Cody Gateway access. In most cases this is not needed, since access tokens are automatically generated from each instance's configured license key.
create-license-key-for-access-token: Create a license key to generate an access token automatically.
access-token-automatic-generation: Once an active subscription has been purchased, an access token will be automatically generated.
changes-propagation-note: Note that changes may take up to 10 minutes to propagate.
